Flat broad strata, sockets, crystal facets and translucent code washes clearly visible beside painted characters; all remain replacement candidates.
Flat lesson-board frame/triangle/circles preserve teaching shape/color semantics; painted classroom/character do not exempt these art roles.
Custom portal style has no visible door outline; stale fixture caption covers floor actor. Flat side-field motifs remain visual art debt; no natural caption-occlusion defect declared.
